title: Prelude in C major
short: Johann Sebastian Bach · C 4/4 · listen, then play it.
trouble: Reading notes one at a time instead of in chunks.

blocks.html: Every bar is one chord, broken into the same pattern and played twice. The left hand holds its two notes while the right hand plays the rest of the chord. Find each chord shape with your hands first, then play the pattern slowly and evenly. Near the end the bass stays on a low G for eight bars befor
What to notice: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book I (1722): Prelude No. 1, BWV 846

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys light up, and “wait for me” lets you practise one hand at a time.

items: holding notes in the left hand

blocks.html: Play through it once with the right hand only, then add the left. Which chord change made you stop?
